Auto plain conversion with accessible names disabled

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert_with_accessible_names, ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia, OutputFormat, TierStrategy

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p><svg aria-label="Name"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>'
    use_accessible_names = False
    options = ConversionOptions(inline_data_media=InlineDataMedia("AltTextOnly"), output_format=OutputFormat("Plain"), tier_strategy=TierStrategy("Auto"))
    result = convert_with_accessible_names(html, use_accessible_names, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
